mapper.sql: select account_id, account_code, platform, account_name, owner_user_id, owner_name, persona, persona_desc, auth_status, publish_mode, daily_publish_cap, paused, pause_reason, paused_by, paused_time, resume_time, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from abr_channel_account
mapper.insert: insert into abr_channel_account (account_code, platform, account_name, owner_user_id, owner_name, persona, persona_desc, auth_status, publish_mode, daily_publish_cap, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{accountCode}, #{platform}, #{accountName}, #{ownerUserId}, coalesce(#{ownerName}, ''), coalesce(#{persona}, 'studio'), coalesce(#{personaDesc}, ''), coalesce(#{authStatus}, 'none'), coalesce(#{publishMode}, 'package'), #{dailyPublishCap}, coalesce(#{status}, '0'), #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update abr_channel_account set account_code = #{accountCode}, platform = #{platform}, account_name = #{accountName}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, owner_name = coalesce(#{ownerName}, ''), persona = coalesce(#{persona}, 'studio'), persona_desc = coalesce(#{personaDesc}, ''), auth_status = coalesce(#{authStatus}, 'none'), publish_mode = coalesce(#{publishMode}, 'package'), daily_publish_cap = #{dailyPublishCap}, status = coalesce(#{status}, '0'), remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.delete: delete from abr_channel_account where account_id in #{id}
mapper.select: select (select count(*) from abr_content where account_id in #{id}) + (select count(*) from abr_publish_record where account_id in #{id})
mapper.update: update abr_channel_account set paused = 'Y', pause_reason = #{reason}, paused_by = #{pausedBy}, paused_time = now(), update_by = #{pausedBy}, update_time = now() where account_code = #{accountCode} and paused = 'N'
update abr_channel_account set paused = 'N', resume_time = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where account_code = #{accountCode} and paused = 'Y'
